1. A tank assembly for a helicopter, the tank assembly comprising:
a retractable tank for storing liquid or other substances, the retractable tank comprising an upper frame structure; and
an attachment mechanism attached to the upper frame structure and configured to engage a main rotor transmission of the helicopter to suspend therefrom.
2. The tank assembly according to claim 1, wherein the attachment mechanism comprises a linking assembly attached to the upper frame structure, and a rod pivotably attached to the linking assembly and extending upwardly therefrom to an upper end portion, the upper end portion of the rod being configured to attach to the main rotor transmission of the helicopter.
3. The tank assembly according to claim 2, wherein the linking assembly comprises a gimbal head defining at least one aperture, and wherein the rod has a lower end portion defining at least one aperture.
4. The tank assembly according to claim 3, further comprising a fastener for securing the gimbal head to the rod, wherein the aperture of the gimbal head and the aperture of the lower end portion of the rod are aligned and fixed by the fastener.
5. The tank assembly according to claim 1, further comprising one or more stabilisation mounts attached to the upper frame structure and configured to attach to the underside of the fuselage of the helicopter.
6. The tank assembly according to claim 5, wherein the upper frame structure has a forward end portion and a rearward end portion, and
wherein the one or more stabilisation mounts comprises two forward mounts attached to the forward end portion and two rearward mounts attached to the rearward end portion.
7. The tank assembly according to claim 6, wherein the upper frame structure has a centre portion between the forward and rearward end portions, and wherein the attachment mechanism is attached to the centre portion.
8. The tank assembly according to claim 1, wherein the retractable tank further comprises a moveable lower frame structure and a flexible bag connected to the upper and lower frame structures, and
wherein the lower frame structure is moveable between a first retracted position in which the lower frame structure is substantially within or adjacent the upper frame structure, and
a second extended position in which the lower frame structure is spaced from the upper frame structure such that a volume is defined within the flexible bag for storing the liquid or other substances.
9. The tank assembly according to claim 8, wherein the lower frame structure is biased to the first retracted position and moves towards the second extended position in response to the amount of liquid or other substance in the volume of the flexible bag.
10. The tank assembly according to claim 9, wherein the lower frame structure is biased to the first retracted position by a retraction system engaged with the upper and lower frame structures.
11. A helicopter comprising:
a fuselage having an underside;
a main rotor transmission; and
a tank assembly comprising:
a retractable tank for storing liquid or other substances, the retractable tank comprising an upper frame structure; and
an attachment mechanism attached to the upper frame structure and engaged with the main rotor transmission to suspend therefrom.
12. The helicopter according to claim 11, wherein the attachment mechanism comprises a linking assembly attached to the upper frame structure, and a rod pivotably attached to the linking assembly and extending upwardly therefrom to an upper end portion, the upper end portion of the rod is attached to the main rotor transmission of the helicopter.
13. The helicopter according to claim 12, wherein the linking assembly comprises a gimbal head defining at least one aperture, and wherein the rod has a lower end portion defining at least one aperture.
14. The helicopter according to claim 13, wherein the tank assembly further comprises a fastener for securing the gimbal head to the rod, wherein the aperture of the gimbal head and the aperture of the lower end portion of the rod are aligned and fixed by the fastener.
15. The helicopter according to claim 11, wherein the tank assembly further comprises one or more stabilisation mounts attached to the upper frame structure and the underside of the fuselage.
16. The helicopter according to claim 15, wherein the upper frame structure has a forward end portion and a rearward end portion, and
wherein the one or more stabilisation mounts comprises two forward mounts attached to the forward end portion and two rearward mounts attached to the rearward end portion.
17. The helicopter according to claim 16, wherein the upper frame structure has a centre portion between the forward and rearward end portions, and wherein the attachment mechanism is attached to the centre portion.
18. The helicopter according to claim 11, wherein the main rotor transmission defines an aperture, and the upper end portion of the rod defines an aperture.
19. The helicopter according to claim 18, further comprising a fastener for securing the rod to the main rotor transmission, wherein the aperture of the upper end portion of the rod and the aperture of the main rotor transmission are aligned and secured by the fastener.
20. The helicopter according to claim 11, wherein the helicopter is a Super Puma helicopter. 16 17 18 19
